% Self-contained fixture for compile.test.ts's "successful compile" case.
%
% Deliberately does NOT use `fontspec`/custom fonts the way the production
% templates (and `test/fixtures/minimal.tex` from Task 2) do: those load
% Plus Jakarta Sans / Noto Sans via an absolute `Path = /opt/fonts/...`,
% which only exists inside the production Docker image (populated by the
% Dockerfile's `COPY assets/fonts/ /opt/fonts/`). On a plain dev machine
% (confirmed: this one) that path doesn't exist, so `minimal.tex` fails
% with "Package fontspec Error: The font ... cannot be found" — a
% test-environment gap, not a bug in compile.ts. This fixture uses only
% Tectonic's bundled default fonts so `compileTex`'s happy path can be
% exercised for real (no mocked subprocess) on any host that merely has the
% `tectonic` binary installed, matching the brief's `it.skip`-if-missing
% spirit for the binary itself while not also requiring the production font
% layout.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Hello, world! Ol\'a, mundo!
\end{document}
